full_prompt_en: A square architectural photograph shows an ornate stone church centered at the far end of an empty courtyard beneath a dramatic slate-gray sky. The lower foreground is a broad, dark paving surface that leads directly to a small warm-lit doorway at the building's center. Long, relatively plain wings border the courtyard on both sides and draw the eye inward, their repeated windows much quieter than the facade beyond them. Across the middle of the frame, the church front is symmetrical in broad outline yet crowded with curved cornices, pilasters, arched windows, and sculptural details. A large pale dome rises from the center, its rounded ribs visible beneath a small open lantern at the summit. Two narrower bell towers stand to the left and right; their open dark arches and irregular decorative silhouettes break against the low clouds. The central facade has several tall windows beneath the dome, with stone columns and recessed shadows giving the wall a deep, layered surface. Near the base, the lit doorway provides a small amber accent amid cold beige stone, charcoal openings, and blue-gray atmosphere. The camera faces the church almost straight on from courtyard level, so the wings converge gently while the dome and towers retain a commanding upright presence. Fine masonry joints and dark weathering collect in the recesses, whereas raised carvings catch the little available light. The overcast sky is the principal light source, brighter behind the upper dome and darker above the flanking towers; soft highlights touch exposed stone while the courtyard remains subdued and shadowed. No people or readable signs interrupt the view. The overall composition joins a measured central axis with dense ornament and looming weather, making the luminous dome emerge from a dark architectural frame.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形建筑照片中，一座华丽石砌教堂居于空旷庭院尽头，头顶是富有戏剧性的石板灰天空。下方前景是一大片深色铺地，视线沿它直达建筑中央那扇透出暖光的小门。庭院两侧由长而相对朴素的翼楼围合，重复的窗户比远处立面安静得多，将目光引向内侧。画面中部的教堂正面在大轮廓上对称，却布满弯曲檐口、壁柱、拱窗与雕塑细节。巨大的浅色穹顶从中央升起，圆弧肋线在顶部一座小型敞口塔亭下清晰可见。左右各立一座较窄的钟楼，其深暗敞口拱券和参差的装饰轮廓剪影在低云前。中央立面在穹顶下方有几列高窗，石柱与后退的阴影让墙体显得深而层叠。靠近底部时，亮着灯的门在冷米色石材、炭灰色开口及蓝灰色空气中提供一点琥珀色强调。相机从庭院高度近乎正对教堂，两侧翼楼轻轻向远处汇聚，穹顶与钟楼仍保持威严的直立感。细砌缝与深色风化痕聚集在凹陷处，凸起雕刻则接住少量天光。阴云天空是主要光源，穹顶背后较亮，两旁钟楼上方较暗；柔和亮面落在外露石材上，庭院则沉在低调阴影中。画面没有人物或可读标识。整体构图以克制的中轴结合繁密装饰与逼近的天气，让发亮的穹顶从深色建筑框架中浮现。
style_prompt_en: The image has a dramatic photographic treatment in which elaborate layered stonework is held within a strong central axis. Curved profiles, projecting moldings, repeated arches, and fine carved relief form a dense, varied edge rhythm against broad unbroken areas. Weathered cream and warm gray surfaces catch thin diffuse light, while nearly charcoal recesses supply depth and definition. Blue-gray clouds cover the upper field, creating a cool atmospheric counterweight to small amber highlights. The patterned surface remains tactile, with joints, stains, and darkened crevices visible rather than smoothed away. A nearly frontal, low viewpoint lets quieter lateral planes guide attention toward a concentrated, ornament-rich center. The illumination is soft but directional in value, with pale exposed surfaces rising out of substantial shade. The overall effect is grand and solemn, combining symmetrical order with restless surface detail and turbulent tonal contrast.
style_prompt_zh: 图像采用富有戏剧性的摄影处理，以强劲中轴统领层叠繁复的石质形体。弯曲轮廓、外挑线脚、重复拱形与精细浮雕在大片完整区域旁形成密集而变化丰富的边缘节奏。风化的奶油色和暖灰色表面接住薄弱的散射光，近乎炭黑的凹处提供深度与清晰界定。蓝灰云层铺满上方色域，与零星琥珀亮点形成冷色大气对照。砌缝、污迹和变暗的缝隙仍清晰可见，材质没有被抹平。近乎正面且较低的视点让安静的侧向平面把注意力引向装饰集中的中央。照明柔和，却有明确的明度层次，使浅色外露表面从厚重暗影里升起。整体效果宏大庄严，把对称秩序与躁动的表面细节、起伏的明暗对比结合起来。
theme_en: An ornate domed church at the end of a stone courtyard beneath storm clouds
theme_zh: 暴风云下石砌庭院尽头的华丽穹顶教堂
name: Baroque architecture
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
